lines.text: Many learners say: I demanded the price to the seller.
Better: I asked the seller for the price.
Demand is strong. Ask is normal.
Ask! Please ask him for help.

data.wrong: I demanded the price to the seller.
data.right: I asked the seller for the price.
data.why: Demand is strong. Ask is normal.

en.tip: « Demander » is “ask”. “Demand” means to require, which sounds very strong.
en.caption: Do you say “I demanded the price to the seller.”? False friend! Say “I asked the seller for the price.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
